clue.text: Go round with a loved one when there's a flap

parts.note: to lap is to go round a track
a pet is a darling or favourite

explanation.surface: Someone circles the room with a sweetheart while everyone is in a panic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flap' in the surface is a panic; here it is the definition, a hanging piece of a garment.
explanation.definitionFit: A lappet is a loose fold or hanging piece on a headdress or garment.

clue.text: Less rot may be written about stable guys

indicators.note: about signals the letters are written out all around, in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone suggests stablemen would write about less decay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be written' is a link; 'about' rearranges LESS ROT.
explanation.definitionFit: Ostlers were the men who looked after horses at an inn's stables.

clue.text: Independent graduates back no society member

parts.note: independent means free
MAs are Masters of Arts, graduates

indicators.note: back means the short word no is read the other way round

explanation.surface: Graduates of an independent college back no society at all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns NO into ON at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A Freemason belongs to a fraternal secret society, the Masons.

clue.text: Contention over a point causing some difficulty

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits over the second

parts.note: a scrap is a fight or dispute
E is a compass point, east

explanation.surface: An argument over a fine point causes trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in a scrape is to be in an awkward predicament.

definitions.meaning: one who tends the sick: a senior hospital nurse
a female sibling, a relation inside the family

explanation.definitionFit: A senior nurse in a British hospital is called by this title, and the word also names a female sibling.

indicators.note: frantic suggests the letters of the words gets near are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A waiter becomes almost hysterical.
explanation.definitionFit: A sergeant is a non-commissioned officer, a man serving in the army.

clue.text: A large number in Israel shoot

indicators.note: in means one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: Sion is a variant spelling of Zion, a name for Israel
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: Many shots are fired in Israel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shoot' looks like a verb about guns; it is a young plant growth.
explanation.definitionFit: A scion is a young shoot or twig, especially one cut for grafting.

clue.text: Some people meet here all the time-it's heavenly!

indicators.note: Some signals that the answer is a part taken from the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: People meeting in this spot all the time find it divine.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethereal means delicate and otherworldly, as of the skies.

clue.text: Separate sailing men and a homily results!

parts.note: ABs are able seamen
a tract is a short moralising pamphlet

explanation.surface: Sailors and a sermon combine, and the results are worth noting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Separate' is a verb here: to abstract is to remove or extract.
explanation.definitionFit: To abstract something is to take it away or extract it from a larger whole.

clue.text: Transport for soldiers going into battle

indicators.note: going into means one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a battle is a fight

explanation.surface: Troops are moved up as they enter combat.
explanation.definitionFit: Freight is goods carried by lorry, ship or train, or the carrying of them.

definitions.meaning: the regular throb of the heart felt at the wrist
the edible seeds of legumes, such as lentils

explanation.definitionFit: The throb felt in an artery shares its name with legume seeds such as peas and lentils.

clue.text: Quietly joining a patrician set without a great show

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside: one piece wraps around the other

parts.note: the gentry are the upper classes

explanation.surface: Discreetly joining aristocratic circles without any grand display.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' means outside here, so GENTRY goes around the second A.
explanation.definitionFit: Pageantry is elaborate ceremonial display and spectacle.

clue.text: A certain craft is needed to see this animal

parts.note: SS stands for steamship, a particular kind of vessel

explanation.surface: You need a special skill to spot this creature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'craft' looks like skill but is a ship; 'see' hints at the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: The donkey is a beast of burden of the horse family.

clue.text: Walks for which caterers may well be disposed

indicators.note: disposed means arranged, so the letters of caterers are set out anew

explanation.surface: Suppliers of food might well be inclined to go strolling.
explanation.definitionFit: A terrace can be a raised level walkway or promenade.

definitions.meaning: a British exclamation of refusal, meaning certainly not

explanation.definitionFit: Literally the phrase means lacking dread; colloquially it is a firm refusal.

parts.note: a good row seems to be a quarrel, but is a session at the oars

explanation.definitionFit: A woman who propels a boat with oars would enjoy rowing.

indicators.note: in means the single letter goes inside the rearranged word
working means the letters of leather are being worked into a new shape

parts.note: L is the learner, as on a learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: A bright apprentice is engaged in leatherwork.

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who is all there is mentally alert and sharp-witted.

indicators.note: written in says the answer is set inside the letters of the words that follow

explanation.surface: Poetry composed in fine English.
explanation.definitionFit: An ode is a lyric poem, a kind of verse.

parts.note: ebon is a poetic word for black
an air is a look or manner

explanation.definitionFit: Debonair means jaunty, cheerful and nonchalant.

indicators.note: returning says the pair of pieces is read backwards

parts.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A Greek returns a message.
explanation.definitionFit: Eta is the seventh letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: A woman wrapping French article in a German one

la is a French definite article

explanation.surface: A woman is wrapping a French item inside a German one.

parts.note: O is the figure zero

explanation.surface: Throw an author a bloom.

clue.text: What a traveller requires to spend on wine

parts.note: to pass time is to spend it
port is a fortified wine

explanation.surface: A traveller needs money to buy wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Crossing borders requires an official identity document.

parts.note: arch means knowing or sly
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A lover of archery is familiar with the royal family.
explanation.definitionFit: A toxophilite is a devotee of archery, one who shoots with a bow.

indicators.note: being disturbed says the letters of nights are jumbled

explanation.surface: Disturbed nights make someone object.
explanation.definitionFit: Things are items or articles, objects in general.

indicators.note: bursting signals the letters of into tears breaking apart and re-forming

explanation.definitionFit: A stationer is a dealer who sells paper and writing materials.

clue.text: Honour the Left and one looks daggers!

indicators.note: accommodation suggests the letters of enlarge are adjusted to fit a new order

explanation.definitionFit: A general is a high-ranking army officer, one of the top brass.

parts.note: giving an account of events, telling a story rather than settling a bill

definitions.meaning: a person who sets type, as in the old printing and paper trade of the tradesman at 26-across
a breed of gun dog, such as the Irish or English breed
